widgets.title: Social sign-in
widgets.description: How many accounts are linked to a sign-in provider and which providers are offered.

permissions.name: oauth:view
permissions.description: See which sign-in providers are connected and which accounts have signed in with them

permissions.name: oauth:unlink
permissions.description: Disconnect a sign-in provider from a user’s account

permissions.name: oauth:settings
permissions.description: Turn sign-in providers on and off and change their client ids and secrets

settings.name: base_url
settings.description: The address this site is reached at, such as https://example.com. Leave empty to work it out from each request, which is fine for a site reached directly but wrong behind a proxy that changes the scheme or host. It is the base of the redirect URI each provider must be told about

settings.name: after_login_path
settings.description: The page a visitor lands on after signing in with a provider, unless the page they came from asked for somewhere else. A path on this site

settings.name: link_verified_emails
settings.description: When someone signs in with a provider that has confirmed their email address, and an account with that address already exists, connect the two instead of refusing. Turn off to make every provider sign-in a separate account

settings.name: privacy_operator
settings.description: Who runs this site, as the privacy policy names them: a person or a company. Leave empty to say "the operator of this site"

settings.name: privacy_contact_email
settings.description: The address people write to about their data. Shown on the privacy policy and the data-deletion page

settings.name: google_enabled
settings.description: Offer "Continue with Google" on the login and register pages. Needs a client id and secret as well

settings.name: google_client_id
settings.description: Google OAuth client id. Not secret — it appears in the address the visitor is sent to

settings.name: google_client_secret
settings.description: Google OAuth client secret. Encrypted at rest and never sent to a browser

settings.name: github_enabled
settings.description: Offer "Continue with GitHub" on the login and register pages. Needs a client id and secret as well

settings.name: github_client_id

groups.name: kempo-oauth:viewer
groups.description: Can see which providers are connected and who has signed in with them, without being able to change anything

groups.name: kempo-oauth:administrator
groups.description: Everything a viewer can do, plus disconnecting accounts and managing the providers’ client ids and secrets
